attributes.action: Introduce Clearer Autism Classifications Based on Support Needs
attributes.additional_details: ASD people can have different experiences and support needs. Many live independently while facing challenges with communication, education, employment or daily life. Many may be non verbal, engage in self-injurious behaviours, significant sensory difficulties, no danger awareness, requiring lifelong care. USA and Australia already recognise differing levels of support needs. We believe the UK should adopt a clearer classification system to improve understanding, support and resource allocation.
attributes.background: Introduce formal autism support levels in the UK. We call on the Government to review autism diagnosis and adopt a clearer classification system, recognising different levels of support needs, including profound autism. To help further support all levels of ASD.
